chain: Google Sheets (canonical, mutable) -> js/sheet.js validated loader -> normalized runtime tutor model
a future tutor added via a Sheet row needs NO new mail-code branch

booking_snapshot.rule: historical emails are never regenerated from later mutable Sheet data; tutorEmailSnapshot is empty unless a verified operational address existed

delivery_state.rule: ACCEPTED is never reported as DELIVERED

ledger: js/ledger.js records contacts BEFORE send (status 'sending') and patches the outcome after
